title: Compile local certificates without claiming global optimality
statement: A k-input gate can enumerate at most3^k partial assignments and solve nonnegative local certificate weights whose compatible sum is1 on every input. Recursively certify selected children; deterministic shared gates are certified once. The full trace has probability gamma_w 1{x_Sw=u_w}, yielding a valid global restoration decomposition without the global exponential LP. Local optimality is not global optimality. For soft positive arithmetic circuits, sum-branch samples must respect occurrence multiplicities: incorrectly reusing one sampled branch for s^2 with s=(x1+x2)/2 gave source TV1/12, while correct occurrence sampling restored exactly. The compiled structure, trace disclosure and finite local optimization are paid.

The complete old transcript R0 has affine likelihood c(R0)1{A_R0 X=b_R0}, with rank r of the entire transcript, including observations selecting later matrices or stopping.
Probe only unprobed columns outside the current disagreement span, using the recorded transcript/matrix and prior unordered pair results; do not inspect unprobed values to choose probes.

Release R0, probe order, unordered pair counts and stopping information. Keep old/new disagreement orientations and protected maintenance computations private; count both probes and independent replacements.

assumptions: Completed source-visible producer result, with no original executable attachment or ZIP acquired and no independent replay, scientific audit, external priority clearance or application advantage. The released record must cover the complete adaptive disclosure and permitted metadata; disagreement old/new orientations remain private. Full old data, selected old values or new value-dependent maintenance logs cannot be silently released. Product-source independence and old/new source-version access are actual assumptions. Cache versions remain correlated. Constant fair-parity cost leaves the old one-pass class; it does not contradict unrestricted worst-source bounds near deterministic laws. The fresh-sketch factory is already competitive, and long balanced parities can be weakly informative.
costs: Conditional on arbitrary complete R0, E[C|R0]<=2r/eta and C<=2n_active. The sharper pre-answer fixed-matrix bound is E[C]<=2r/d, d=min_i 2p_i(1-p_i), and is not a conditional-current-answer bound.

Initial cache, dense matrix reading, rank/segment-tree acquisition, large bit vectors, model-version access and storage are paid. Source reports O(r^2 log n) bit-vector operations per probe and O(r|S|) sketch maintenance, plus word-length costs.

The reported3000-round4096-coordinate implementation used105734 subsequent calls, mean35.2447, with changing versions/columns. This is producer implementation evidence, not a total-work or inference advantage.

An equally informed fresh-sketch factory uses comparable source calls. Fair parity restoration costs4(1-2^-n)<4, but long parities have bias at most(1-2eta)^support and near-deterministic sources can cost near2n.

The exact finite-state and approximate tests are producer reports; original code was unavailable. The joint approximation factor is2epsilon, with finite-horizon sum2sum_t epsilon_t under history-uniform full-channel assumptions.
